title: Assistant Axis Method BYOD Row
description: Rows for default-vs-role contrast derivation or precomputed Assistant Axis / trait scoring. Domains are arbitrary; role labels need not be personas.

model_id.description: Model used for capture; must match any precomputed coordinate family.

axis_kind.description: Required for deriving a new axis. Optional for scoring-only rows.

role.description: Group name for the non-default condition, e.g. pirate, terse, analyst, policy_mode_a.

adherence_score.description: Optional quality/intensity score used to filter role examples before axis derivation.
